findings_qualitative.value: SO and SO2 trace cavity walls at systemic velocity, a wide-angle outflow at low velocity, and the collimated fast jet at high velocity

evidence.quote: these molecules probe different components in the inner $\sim 1300$ AU of the HH 212 protostellar system

findings_qualitative.value: No velocity gradient across the jet axis detected; jet unresolved transversally

evidence.quote: The figure shows no evidence of a velocity gradient across the jet axis

claims.hypothesis: SO and SO2 trace the molecular jet in HH 212
claims.experiment: Channel maps, PVs and knot spectra compared with CO and SiO
claims.result: At |V|>~8 km/s SO PV is similar to CO and SiO; knots B3, B2, R2 identified
claims.finding: SO and SO2 are effective jet tracers within a few hundred AU

evidence.quote: for velocities larger than $\sim +/- 8$ km s$^{-1}$  the PV diagram of SO along the jet is very similar to that of CO 3–2 and SiO 8–7

claims.hypothesis: The jet carries a high mass flux and ejection efficiency
claims.experiment: CO column density to Mdot_jet at knots

evidence.quote: indicating an high jet efficiency ($\dot{M}_{\rm jet}/\dot{M}_{\rm inf} \ge 0.03-0.3$)

claims.hypothesis: SO 10(11)-10(10) arises partly in the rotating disk
claims.experiment: Channel maps and PVs of SO 10-10 compared with C17O
claims.result: Peaks displaced along disk axis at 1.9-3.5 km/s; PV across jet shows rotation-like lobes
claims.finding: Emission from both the disk and the jet base, with SO abundance 1e-8 to 1e-7 in the disk

evidence.quote: This indicates that SO 10$_{11}$-10$_{10}$ traces partly rotating gas in a flattened envelope and/or in a disk, and partly the jet.

claims.hypothesis: SO enhancement in disk is explained by shocks
claims.experiment: Compare disk SO abundance with evolved disks
claims.result: 3-4 orders of magnitude above evolved disks
claims.finding: Accretion shock or spiral shocks possible but not distinguished

evidence.quote: the presented ALMA observations do not allow us to distinguish between these scenarios

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Line broadening due to conical jet geometry versus internal jet shock/bowshock; bowshock favoured by earlier work

evidence.loc: 3.3 The fast and collimated molecular jet
evidence.quote: The bowshock scenario is favored by (cite: codella07) and further supported by the SiO maps and transverse PVs of (cite: lee08).

limitations_admitted.value: Resolution too low to fully resolve the disk; edge-on view unfavourable

evidence.quote: The angular resolution ($\sim 0.5\ensuremath{''}$) is too low to fully resolve the disk

limitations_admitted.value: Mass loss rate is a lower limit and uncertain by factor ~3; SO data cannot constrain density and temperature

evidence.loc: 4.2 SO and SO2 abundance in the jet
evidence.quote: the avalaible SO observations do not allow constraining the density and temperature of the emitting gas

referee_caveats_inferred: Abundances rely on assumed X_CO=1e-4 and a wide Tex range of 50-500 K
SO2 assumed co-spatial with CO over a narrow velocity range
No formal uncertainties or fitting; ranges only
Single low-resolution Cycle 0 dataset; disk and jet-base contributions to SO 10-10 are not separated
